free_tier.stated: The Student Pack is quoted as '10 JetBrains IDEs - the full versions of IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm, plus GoLand, PhpStorm, and others' plus a 'JetBrains AI Pro trial', verified by 'your university email address, ISIC/ITIC card, or GitHub Student Developer Pack', and 'Once your account is verified, you'll receive a pack valid for one year'. Beside it, and needing no verification: 'For students who only need one IDE for a class, a personal project, or the language they're learning - no student verification required', naming IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, CLion, WebStorm, RustRover, Rider, RubyMine and DataGrip.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The ISIC route is the interesting one because it sounds like an international card anyone can buy; the ISIC issuer's own help centre closes it, since the card itself demands dated proof of full-time enrollment. That makes the four JetBrains routes one gate, not four.
limits_note: No compute is involved, so no technical quota binds; the only bound is that the full pack needs enrollment proof while the one-IDE routes need nothing and give less.
binding_note: No compute is involved, so no technical quota binds; the only bound is that the full pack needs enrollment proof while the one-IDE routes need nothing and give less.

identity_cost.detail: student status, by one of four routes the application form lists: "University email address", "ISIC/ITIC membership", "Official document" or "GitHub". The ISIC route is not a bypass, because the card is "only available to full time students", who must prove current full-time study by student ID card or a signed and dated letter on official stationery. No card, phone, hold or payment is stated, and the pack is "valid for one year" with annual renewal; the one-IDE licences need "no student verification required" but carry no compute

evidence.proved: 'Verify your student status with your university email address, ISIC/ITIC card, or GitHub Student Developer Pack'; one-IDE options say 'no student verification required'; the pack is 'valid for one year' and renewed annually.
The application form offers exactly four verification routes: 'University email address', 'ISIC/ITIC membership', 'Official document', 'GitHub'.

The ISIC card is not an alternative to enrollment proof: 'The ISIC is only available to full time students, so you must be able to prove you are currently studying full time at school, college or university', by student ID card or 'a signed and dated letter on official university or school stationery'.

notes: Refutation of a specific hypothesis: ISIC is not a bypass. It narrows nothing. The non-commercial IDE licence is genuinely reachable and genuinely irrelevant to compute. The JetBrains AI Pro trial is the only part with any inference value, and it is a trial.
